cat > /workspace/tests/test_lifecycle.py << 'EOF'
import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tests')
from harness import *

def doc(cases, events, channels=None, definitions=None, timeout_ms=10, seed='s'):
    return {'seed': seed, 'definitions': definitions or [], 'timeout_ms': timeout_ms,
            'cases': cases, 'events': events, 'channels': channels or []}

def case(name, frames, method='GET', target='/a', host='h.example'):
    return {'name': name, 'frames': frames,
            'expect': {'method': method, 'target': target, 'host': host}}

def hf(pairs, end=False):
    return {'Type': 'headers', 'data_to_transfered': [[k, v] for k, v in pairs], 'End_Stream': end}

def df(data, end=True):
    return {'Type': 'data', 'data_to_transfered': data, 'End_Stream': end}

def gf(data):
    return {'Type': 'datagram', 'data_to_transfered': data}

def sl(ms):
    return {'Type': 'sleep', 'Time_to_Stop': ms}

def ev_headers(at, stream, fields, end):
    return {'at': at, 'kind': 'headers', 'stream': stream, 'fields': fields, 'end': end}

def ev_data(at, stream, data, end):
    return {'at': at, 'kind': 'data', 'stream': stream, 'data': data, 'end': end}

def ev_close(at):
    return {'at': at, 'kind': 'close'}

# ---- 1. basic timeout -------------------------------------------------
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [hf([(':method','GET')], end=True)])], [], timeout_ms=5))
c = r['cases'][0]
check('timeout state/at', c['state'] == 'timeout' and c['at'] == 5, c)
sent = act(0, 0, 'H', [(b':method', b'GET')], True)
check('timeout sent receipt', c['sent'] == fp(sent), c['sent'])
check('timeout received empty', c['received'] == fp(b'') and c['response_frames'] == 0)
check('timeout counts', c['frames'] == 1 and c['request_frames'] == 1 and c['payload_bytes'] == 7)

# ---- 2. ok at event time ---------------------------------------------
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [hf([(':method','GET')], end=True)])],
                [ev_headers(3, 0, [[':status','200']], True)], timeout_ms=5))
c = r['cases'][0]
check('ok state/at', c['state'] == 'ok' and c['at'] == 3, c)
recv = act(3, 0, 'h', [(b':status', b'200')], True)
check('ok received receipt', c['received'] == fp(recv), c['received'])
check('ok response counts', c['response_frames'] == 1 and c['response_body'] == fp(b''))

# ---- 3. close during pause -------------------------------------------
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [hf([('a','b')]), sl(10), df('x')])],
                [ev_close(3)], timeout_ms=5))
c = r['cases'][0]
check('closed during pause', c['state'] == 'closed' and c['at'] == 3 and c['frames'] == 1, c)

# ---- 4. send error ----------------------------------------------------
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [hf([('a','b')], end=True), df('x')])], [], timeout_ms=5))
c = r['cases'][0]
check('send_error', c['state'] == 'send_error' and c['at'] == 0 and c['frames'] == 1, c)
sent = act(0, 0, 'H', [(b'a', b'b')], True)
check('send_error sent receipt', c['sent'] == fp(sent), c['sent'])

# ---- 5. datagram after request end = send error ------------------------
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [hf([('a','b')], end=True), gf('x')])], [], timeout_ms=5))
c = r['cases'][0]
check('datagram after end send_error', c['state'] == 'send_error' and c['frames'] == 1, c)

# ---- 6. sleep after request end is fine -------------------------------
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [hf([('a','b')], end=True), sl(4)])],
                [ev_headers(2, 0, [['s','2']], True)], timeout_ms=5))
c = r['cases'][0]
check('sleep after end ok at send-finish(4)', c['state'] == 'ok' and c['at'] == 4, c)

# ---- 7. response end during pause -> ok at send finish -----------------
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [sl(5), df('x')])],
                [ev_headers(2, 0, [['s','2']], True)], timeout_ms=5))
c = r['cases'][0]
check('retained end while sending', c['state'] == 'ok' and c['at'] == 5 and c['frames'] == 1, c)
recv = act(2, 0, 'h', [(b's', b'2')], True)
check('retained end receipt at accept time', c['received'] == fp(recv), c['received'])

# ---- 8. end does not cancel remaining frames --------------------------
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [hf([('a','b')]), sl(5), df('x', end=True)])],
                [ev_headers(1, 0, [['s','2']], True)], timeout_ms=5))
c = r['cases'][0]
check('end keeps sending', c['state'] == 'ok' and c['at'] == 5 and c['frames'] == 2, c)

# ---- 9. tied response event wins over timeout -------------------------
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [hf([('a','b')], end=True)])],
                [ev_headers(5, 0, [['s','2']], True)], timeout_ms=5))
c = r['cases'][0]
check('tie: response wins', c['state'] == 'ok' and c['at'] == 5, c)

# ---- 10. close at deadline beats timeout ------------------------------
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [hf([('a','b')], end=True)])], [ev_close(5)], timeout_ms=5))
c = r['cases'][0]
check('tie: close beats timeout', c['state'] == 'closed' and c['at'] == 5, c)

# ---- 11. later close cannot replace timeout ---------------------------
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [hf([('a','b')], end=True)])], [ev_close(7)], timeout_ms=5))
c = r['cases'][0]
check('later close keeps timeout', c['state'] == 'timeout' and c['at'] == 5, c)

# ---- 12. close then response event ignored ----------------------------
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [sl(10), df('x')])],
                [ev_close(2), ev_data(3, 0, 'yy', True)], timeout_ms=5))
c = r['cases'][0]
check('events after close ignored', c['state'] == 'closed' and c['response_frames'] == 0 and c['received'] == fp(b''), c)

# ---- 13. response end then close at same time: input order ------------
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [hf([('a','b')], end=True)])],
                [ev_headers(2, 0, [['s','2']], True), ev_close(2)], timeout_ms=5))
c = r['cases'][0]
check('end before close -> ok', c['state'] == 'ok' and c['at'] == 2, c)
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [hf([('a','b')], end=True)])],
                [ev_close(2), ev_headers(2, 0, [['s','2']], True)], timeout_ms=5))
c = r['cases'][0]
check('close before end -> closed', c['state'] == 'closed' and c['at'] == 2 and c['response_frames'] == 0, c)

# ---- 14. case start beats same-time close -----------------------------
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [hf([('a','b')], end=True)])], [ev_close(0)], timeout_ms=5))
c = r['cases'][0]
check('start beats close at 0', c['state'] == 'closed' and c['at'] == 0 and c['frames'] == 1, c)

# ---- 15. unknown stream / late events / multiple ends -----------------
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [hf([('a','b')], end=True)])],
                [ev_headers(1, 4, [['s','2']], True),
                 ev_headers(1, 0, [['s','2']], True),
                 ev_headers(2, 0, [['t','3']], True),
                 ev_data(2, 0, 'zz', False)], timeout_ms=5))
c = r['cases'][0]
check('unknown + post-end events ignored', c['response_frames'] == 1 and c['received'] == fp(act(1, 0, 'h', [(b's', b'2')], True)), c)

# ---- 16. accepted events stay after later timeout ---------------------
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [hf([('a','b')], end=True)])],
                [ev_data(1, 0, 'xy', False)], timeout_ms=5))
c = r['cases'][0]
check('events kept on timeout', c['state'] == 'timeout' and c['response_frames'] == 1 and
      c['received'] == fp(act(1, 0, 'd', b'xy', False)), c)
check('response_body', c['response_body'] == fp(b'xy'), c['response_body'])

# ---- 17. accepted events stay after close -----------------------------
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [sl(9), df('x')])],
                [ev_data(1, 0, 'xy', False), ev_close(4)], timeout_ms=5))
c = r['cases'][0]
check('events kept on close', c['state'] == 'closed' and c['at'] == 4 and
      c['received'] == fp(act(1, 0, 'd', b'xy', False)), c)

# ---- 18. multi-data response body and mixed receipt --------------------
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [hf([('a','b')], end=True)])],
                [ev_headers(1, 0, [['s','2']], False),
                 ev_data(2, 0, 'ab', False),
                 ev_data(3, 0, 'cd', True)], timeout_ms=5))
c = r['cases'][0]
recv = act(1, 0, 'h', [(b's', b'2')], False) + act(2, 0, 'd', b'ab', False) + act(3, 0, 'd', b'cd', True)
check('multi-event receipt', c['received'] == fp(recv), c['received'])
check('multi-event body', c['response_body'] == fp(b'abcd') and c['response_frames'] == 3)

# ---- 19. datagram accounting ------------------------------------------
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [gf('dd'), hf([('a','b')]), df('xy', end=True)])],
                [ev_headers(1, 0, [['s','2']], True)], timeout_ms=5))
c = r['cases'][0]
sent = act(0, 0, 'G', b'dd', False) + act(0, 0, 'H', [(b'a', b'b')], False) + act(0, 0, 'D', b'xy', True)
check('datagram accounting', c['frames'] == 3 and c['request_frames'] == 2 and
      c['payload_bytes'] == 2 + 2 + 2 and c['sent'] == fp(sent), c)

# ---- 20. pause ordering vs events at same time -------------------------
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [sl(5), df('x', end=True)])],
                [ev_close(5)], timeout_ms=5))
c = r['cases'][0]
check('close beats pause completion', c['state'] == 'closed' and c['at'] == 5 and c['frames'] == 0, c)

# ---- 21. zero pause yields ---------------------------------------------
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [sl(0), df('x', end=True)])],
                [ev_close(0)], timeout_ms=5))
c = r['cases'][0]
check('zero pause yields to close', c['state'] == 'closed' and c['at'] == 0 and c['frames'] == 0, c)

# ---- 22. multi case streams and independence ---------------------------
r = run_obj(doc([case('a', [hf([('x','1')], end=True)]),
                 case('b', [sl(3), df('q')])],
                [ev_headers(1, 0, [['s','2']], True), ev_close(2)], timeout_ms=5))
ca, cb = r['cases']
check('stream ids', ca['stream'] == 0 and cb['stream'] == 4)
check('case a ok', ca['state'] == 'ok' and ca['at'] == 1, ca)
check('case b closed', cb['state'] == 'closed' and cb['at'] == 2 and cb['frames'] == 0, cb)

# ---- 23. empty frames case ---------------------------------------------
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [])], [ev_data(4, 0, 'z', True)], timeout_ms=5))
c = r['cases'][0]
check('empty frames ok on end', c['state'] == 'ok' and c['at'] == 4 and c['frames'] == 0 and c['request_frames'] == 0, c)
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [])], [], timeout_ms=5))
c = r['cases'][0]
check('empty frames timeout', c['state'] == 'timeout' and c['at'] == 5 and c['sent'] == fp(b''), c)

# ---- 24. exact output keys ---------------------------------------------
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [hf([('a','b')], end=True)])],
                [ev_headers(1, 0, [['s','2']], True)], timeout_ms=5))
check('case record keys', set(r['cases'][0]) == {'name','stream','state','at','frames','request_frames',
    'payload_bytes','sent','received','response_frames','response_body','origin_count','flags'}, r['cases'][0].keys())
check('root keys', set(r) == {'cases','channels'})

summary()
